title: Osteoblast Biospecific Extraction Conjugated with HPLC Analysis for Screening Bone Regeneration Active Components from Moutan Cortex.
authors: Yao, Fei; Chen, Wei; Gu, Weiwei; Xu, Heng; Hou, Wenyue; Liang, Guoqiang; Zhang Zhu, Ruixian; Jiang, Guorong; Zhang, Lurong
one_liner_zh: 该文用成骨细胞膜生物特异性提取结合HPLC筛选中药活性成分，并用分子对接评估PGG与ALP/BMP2/Smad1结合，但核心是药物小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: The function of promoting bone regeneration of Moutan Cortex (MC), a traditional Chinese medicine, has been widely known but, the effective components of MC in promoting osteoblast-mediated bone regeneration were still unclear. OBJECTIVE: The method of osteoblast membrane bio-specific extraction conjugated with HPLC analysis was established to screen bone regeneration active components from MC. METHODS: The fingerprints, washing eluate and desorption eluate of MC extract were analyzed by the established HPLC-DAD method. The established MC3T3-E1 cells membrane chromatography method was used for the bio-specific extraction of MC. The isolated compounds were identified by MS spectrometry. The effects and possible mechanisms of the isolated compounds were evaluated by molecular docking, ALP activity, cell viability by MTT Assay and proteins expression by Western Blot Analysis. RESULTS: The active compound responsible for bone regeneration from MC was isolated using the established method of osteoblast membrane bio-specific extraction conjugated with HPLC analysis, and it was identified as 1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-beta-galloyl-D-glucose (PGG) by MS spectrometry. It was further demonstrated through molecular docking that PGG could fit well into the functional ALP, BMP2, and Samd1 binding pocket. The proliferation of osteoblasts was promoted, the level of ALP was increased, and the protein expression of BMP2 and Smad1 was increased as shown by further pharmacological verification. CONCLUSION: It was concluded that PGG, the bone regeneration active compound from MC, could stimulate the proliferation of osteoblasts to promote osteoblast differentiation, and its mechanism might be related to the BMP/Smad1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 引言：传统中药牡丹皮（Moutan Cortex, MC）促进骨再生的功能已广为人知，但MC中促进成骨细胞介导骨再生的有效成分仍不明确。目的：建立成骨细胞膜生物特异性提取结合HPLC分析的方法，从MC中筛选骨再生活性成分。方法：采用所建立的HPLC-DAD方法分析MC提取物的指纹图谱、洗涤洗脱液和解吸洗脱液。利用所建立的MC3T3-E1细胞膜色谱法对MC进行生物特异性提取。分离得到的化合物通过质谱（MS）鉴定。通过分子对接、ALP活性、MTT法检测细胞活力及Western Blot分析蛋白表达，评估分离化合物的作用及可能机制。结果：利用所建立的成骨细胞膜生物特异性提取结合HPLC分析方法，从MC中分离出负责骨再生的活性化合物，并通过质谱鉴定为1,2,3,4,6-五-O-β-没食子酰-D-葡萄糖（PGG）。进一步通过分子对接证明，PGG能良好地嵌入功能性ALP、BMP2和Smad1的结合口袋。进一步的药理学验证显示，成骨细胞增殖被促进，ALP水平升高，BMP2和Smad1的蛋白表达增加。结论：PGG作为MC中的骨再生活性化合物，能刺激成骨细胞增殖以促进成骨细胞分化，其机制可能与BMP/Smad1通路相关。
